customManagers.description: The flash-attn wheel is pinned by the FLASH_ATTN_VERSION build arg and downloaded from the project's GitHub release, so it is tracked against those releases rather than PyPI (whose sdist would compile for an hour).

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves once the checks pass
docker-compose.yml is the usage example and names this repo's own image on purpose; pinning or bumping it there would only ever point readers at a stale digest

Hold pytorch/pytorch on 2.6.0 and move only its digest: the flash-attn release wheel the Dockerfile installs is built for torch 2.6, and newer torch tags (2.14+) swap conda for Ubuntu's PEP 668 system Python, so a bump needs a new wheel and a Dockerfile change together. Lift this once a flash-attn release ships a wheel for the new torch.
A base-image, pip or flash-attn bump changes the published image, so it is a fix: release-please cuts a patch release for it. Workflow-action bumps stay chores and release nothing.
